usedFor: Envoy for Visitors records invites, and “Visitor Invited” can run “Share File” in Google Drive.

bestTemplate.name: “Visitor Invited” in Envoy for Visitors, then “Share File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: An invited visitor gets access to a file you choose, as Viewer, Commenter or Editor.

watchOut: “Visitor Invited” in Envoy for Visitors is polling, so the share happens after a scheduled check.
